topic_title: Definition of Traffic Flow & Operational Dynamics
prompt: What does Texas Transportation Code §545.351 (the Basic Speed Rule) require when traffic density increases?

options.text: Maintain posted maximum speed limits to prevent slowing surrounding flow
Reduce vehicle speed below posted limits to what is reasonable and prudent
Shift into the left-hand median lane and flash hazard lights continuously
Sound the vehicle horn intermittently to clear forward roadway congestion
